Name: Special Orders for Auto-Petter for 1.6
Author: LCKa
Description:
Update to 1.1.0: fixed a bug that made it available even when the conditions weren't fulfilled. Thank you MingSoogaroon for alerting me about the bug.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tarniyar's original mod (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7534]here[/url]) was a welcome addition to my gameplay, bypassing the need for the Joja route and making the AutoPetter available at Marnie's shop after you completed a special order from her. I loved having to do something specifically for her before she expanded her stock, it made the reward feel more personal. But SDV 1.6 made Shop Tile Framework obsolete, so even though the bulk of Tarniyar's mod remained perfectly functional, the item wasn't sold at the shop. So I made it compatible with 1.6 with a few edits, and Tarniyar kindly gave me permission to post it.

Nothing else has changed, the text in the mail is still the same, etc. The translations that came with the mod are still there, so thank you to the original translators. All kudos should go to Tarniyar for the original mod, but for technical inquiries come to me, please. If there's a problem I'll try to help as soon as possible.

Thank you again, Tarniyar, for giving me permission to publish this.

Only Content Patcher is required. It should work on old and new saves alike, although if you are at least in year 3 and due to some other mod, Marnie's special order no longer appears, it will be an issue.

Below are Tarniyar's original description and credits for the game.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Anyway, I was really disappointed to learn that the Auto-Petter is only available after completing the Joja route.  I always play the Community
Center route because it's more fun.  And I don't want to miss out on such a useful machine!

I've tried to keep things balanced.  Here's what the mod adds:

[list]
[*]After the Community Center is completed, Marnie will ask for two special orders (one in spring, and one in fall).  
[*]Completing either special order will reward the player with the Auto-Petter being available to purchase from Marnie.  It will show up the day after  you see the letter, two days after completing the special order.
[*]Marnie sells the Auto-Petter for 65,000.  This is more expensive than the Joja price to try to keep things fair.
[/list]
Spring Special Order Details:

Harvest 10 melons
Deliver 10 pink cakes to Marnie

Fall Special Order Details

Harvest 10 pumpkins
Deliver 10 pumpkin pies to Marnie


[b]Many thanks to the following for the translations:
[/b]
Spanish translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/101231458]BettaZero[/url]
German translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2717013]epicBastard[/url]
